target: one path identifier joining geometry, action, complex amplitude and phase

candidates.action: computed standard optical/free-particle action from the path sequence
candidates.complex_amplitude: reconstructible as a product of experimentally reconstructed propagator elements
candidates.phase: argument of the reconstructed complex path amplitude

candidates.geometry: full coordinates only for selected stationary-action candidates
candidates.complex_amplitude: not published for the same indexed path family
candidates.verdict: strong action-side control, incomplete joint packet

executed_score.null: complex path weight factors through the standard step action
executed_score.diagnostic: test amplitude or phase residual against path roughness, turning count and increment distribution conditional on total action
executed_score.mandatory_control: cluster or bootstrap by shared propagator element; 17^5 algebraically generated paths are not 17^5 independent measurements
executed_score.verdict: validated phase leg is consistent with the 17-class shared-kernel permutation null; amplitude leg fails independent reconstruction validation
executed_score.forbidden_promotion: a residual may diagnose propagator-structure information beyond scalar total action, but does not identify Tau body action
